title: ComplaintCase - Data API
description: Represents the association between an HR complaint and a case. This object is available in API version 67.0 and later.

CaseId.description: The ID of the Case record associated with this complaint for tracking investigation and resolution activities. This field is a relationship field.

LastReferencedDate.description: The date and time when the complaint case record was last referenced.

LastViewedDate.description: The date and time when the complaint case record was last viewed.

Name.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
Name.description: The auto-generated unique identifier for the complaint case record.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: The ID of the User or Group who owns this complaint case record. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

PublicComplaintId.description: The ID of the PublicComplaint record linked to this case. This field is a relationship field.

associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. If the API version isn’t specified, they’re available in the same API versions as this object. Otherwise, they’re available in the specified API version and later.

- **ComplaintCaseChangeEvent**: Change events are available for the object.
- **ComplaintCaseFeed**: Feed tracking is available for the object.
- **ComplaintCaseHistory**: History is available for tracked fields of the object.
- **ComplaintCaseOwnerSharingRule**: Sharing rules are available for the object.
- **ComplaintCaseShare**: Sharing is available for the object.
